news.title: Aligning AI with pedagogy, privacy, and outcomes
news.summary_en: In a peer-reviewed study at Los Angeles Pacific University, students using a pedagogically-aligned AI assistant saw a 20 percent increase in GPA, a 13 percent increase in final scores, and a 36 percent increase in intrinsic motivation to learn.

news.title: Designing for finals: How campus shapes the way students work
news.summary_en: Finals week is often treated as a question of whether there is enough study space on campus. Are there enough quiet seats, extended library hours, and places to concentrate?
